notes:
- Portable and encrypted: runs from a folder or USB drive without installation; all data is stored encrypted next to the app
- Accounts (customers, suppliers, personnel), receivables and payables, collections and payments in any currency or precious metal
- Installment plans, due tracking, day closing, corrections and cancellations with a full audit trail
- Home page with charts: last 12 months of sales vs. collections and purchases vs. payments, receivables aging, cash movement of the last 30 days
- Reports: account statement, category, personnel, due dates, weekly and monthly cash flow, aging, rate history, closed days
- 15 themes with their own menu layouts, light and dark mode, 48 accent colors and 20 fonts; 10 languages including right-to-left
- Compressed, encrypted automatic and manual backups; a transfer package for moving to a new computer
- Demo records: sample data for every day since the start of the year (Settings > Security)
- Security password that wipes the data and opens with sample data when used under pressure
- Signed automatic updates on Windows (x64, ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon, Intel) and Linux
